Your product, presented properly

A free listing gets the same care as any other: your screens, your words, your price as you state it. Our research sits next to it, clearly labelled, and you cannot edit it — which is exactly why a listing here means something.

  • Your own description, logo and screenshots at the top of your page
  • Our independent research beside it, with dates and sources
  • An optional “Listed on AIBuilder Marketplace” badge. No backlink required
List or claim your product
The optional badge, linking to your listing
How this marketplace works

Every tool we have researched has a page here with our own work on it, and vendors can list tools we have not researched yet: the pricing we read with the date we read it, the cost conditions with the sentence each one rests on, who the tool suits and who should skip it. Where a vendor has claimed its page, its own description sits above that research, and it cannot edit our half. Where nobody has claimed it, the page says so. Reader reviews sit underneath, critical ones included.

For vendors

Listing is free during the beta. The conditions are the ones we hold ourselves to: real pricing, no invented claims, and readers keep the last word. Outbound links a vendor submits carry nofollow ugc, and pages that only hold our research are noindex, so they never compete with our reviews. Our audience is still modest and growing; we would rather say that here than have you find out afterwards.
